% Naive SMV encoding: one SMV transition per internal BT step.
\documentclass[border=6pt,tikz]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usepackage{amsmath, amssymb}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta, positioning, decorations.pathreplacing}

\tikzset{
  state/.style    = {draw, circle, fill=blue!10, minimum size=7mm, inner sep=0pt, font=\small},
  step/.style     = {draw, rounded corners=2pt, fill=orange!15, align=center,
                     font=\scriptsize, minimum width=1.5cm, minimum height=0.65cm, inner sep=3pt},
  flow/.style     = {-{Latex[length=2mm]}, line width=0.55pt, shorten >=1pt, shorten <=1pt},
  note/.style     = {font=\scriptsize, text=black!70, align=center},
}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[node distance=0.4cm]

\node[state] (n0) {$s_0$};
\node[step, right=of n0] (a) {enter\\root};
\node[state, right=of a] (n1) {$s_1$};
\node[step, right=of n1] (b) {tick $c_1$};
\node[state, right=of b] (n2) {$s_2$};
\node[step, right=of n2] (c) {tick $c_2$};
\node[state, right=of c] (n3) {$s_3$};
\node[step, right=of n3] (d) {tick $a$};
\node[state, right=of d] (n4) {$s_4$};
\node[step, right=of n4] (e) {update\\blackboard};
\node[state, right=of e] (n5) {$s_5$};

\foreach \x/\y in {n0/a, a/n1, n1/b, b/n2, n2/c, c/n3, n3/d, d/n4, n4/e, e/n5}
  \draw[flow] (\x) -- (\y);

% Give the brace ~12pt of vertical margin below the chain to avoid
% overlap with the round state nodes at the bottom of the chain.
\draw[decorate, decoration={brace, amplitude=5pt, mirror},
      thick, black!55]
      ([yshift=-14pt]n0.south west) -- node[below=7pt, note]
        {six SMV transitions encode one BT tick}
      ([yshift=-14pt]n5.south east);

\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
